g.text: Assumptions: random sample; in (b), software that behaves normally in the test without biometrics. It does not describe how an attack would

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5a5f66

g.text: be carried out. The vertical lines show the fraction of sections that would have to be altered to change the margin of 4,430,191 votes.
